text_block_list.text:
—The time is ripe. The first three years 
of the Twinkle Series have passed—now is 
our chance.
choice_data_list: Desire, do you remember this ticket?
Desire, do you remember this ticket?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
! That hot spring trip ticket is from the 
lottery... ...The time has finally come to 
use it!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go on a hot springs trip!
Yeah, let's go on a hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Yes, let's go! Since we're there, we 
could do some sightseeing too...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! Shall we tour the ley 
lines?
choice_data_list:
An energy spot... Oh, you mean a power 
spot?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes! When the spirit flow aligns and my 
saintly power ascends... the world shall 
bestow a new blessing upon me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"That is the first step into an alternate 
realm. The opening chapter of the New 
Saint's legend...!"

I'd only intended to take a normal 
breather, but... Thinking it might help 
her, I nodded with a smile.

And thus, the hot spring trip combined 
with our tour of power spots began well 
before dawn broke.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Gasp! How could I...? Right in the middle 
of my trial to fend off drowsiness...
choice_data_list:
Haha, well, I do have to get up at 4 a.m. 
and all.

Hehe, well, I do wake up at 4 AM, after 
all

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"This is also proof of my inexperience. 
Once I tour the power spots, I should be 
able to overcome it."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now then. The first energy spot is at the 
top of that knoll. Let us hasten onward!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I feel it. The awakening of the 
Saintly Power that slumbered deep within 
me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
... I feel a much stronger presence coming 
from this direction...
choice_data_list:
Ah, wait! If you don't open your eyes it's 
dange—

text_block_list.name: Sound of Head Bumping
text_block_list.text: (Thump!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ouch!? ...Ugh, a new trial already...!?
choice_data_list:
...Just to be safe, let's rest a bit 
before we go.

...Just to be safe, let's rest a bit 
before we go.

text_block_list.text:
After descending the small hill, we headed 
to the second spiritual spot—a historic 
temple.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Not a single sound came out. 
...Surely it means my saintly power is 
still lacking.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"However, this is the Flute of Trials... 
When its true melody rings out, the saint 
shall surely—gain new power."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...I told you!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Phoo! Phoo! ……Phoo!

text_block_list.name: Temple Head Priest
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha. What a young lady of truly 
wonderful spirit.
choice_data_list: Yes, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Phoo, phoo. ……Pant, pant. Phoo, 
phoo………………Honk~♪

We visited as many energy spots as time 
allowed after that, and by the time we 
reached the inn, we were completely worn 
out.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Phew... As expected, acquiring ki comes 
with its share of trials.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However, this hot spring is the final and 
greatest power spot.
choice_data_list: Wait, really?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I hear that soaking in the pure 
waters blessed by the earth grants you an 
immense amount of spiritual energy.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Let us be on our way, Trainer. It is time 
for the finale of my training♪
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Just as rumored, the bath was 
simply wonderful♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Qi fills me to the tips of my limbs, my 
body surges warmly... this is the ultimate 
qi field."
choice_data_list:
Ah, that's right. Mind if I stop by the 
kiosk for a bit?

Oh, right. Mind if we stop by the shop for 
a bit?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the school store? Certainly, but what 
will you be purchasing?
choice_data_list:
I wanted to try their famous 'onsen 
pudding'...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Come to think of it, I saw that when I 
was researching earlier... Let us 
definitely go!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Huh, is it sold out?

text_block_list.name: Employee
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply sorry. This is an extremely 
popular item, and just a moment ago, all 
of them...
choice_data_list: Oh, what a shame.

text_block_list.name: Employee
text_block_list.text:
If only you were a little earlier... alas. 
Please come by earlier tomorrow.
choice_data_list: Understood, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: (If only I had been a little faster...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(If only I had overcome the ordeal a 
little sooner...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... of course. It is because Trainer is 
always by my side...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(When trials were thrust upon me, it must 
have placed quite a heavy burden on him as 
well.)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(When trials were thrust upon me, it must 
have placed quite a heavy burden on her as 
well.)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: (That's quite a...)
choice_data_list: —Red Desire?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
choice_data_list:
What's wrong? You've been spacing out for 
a while now.

What's wrong? You've been spacing out for 
a while now.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...That incident with the pudding earlier 
made me realize something. With these 
trials of mine, I have placed a great 
burden upon you."
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However... even so, I cannot neglect my 
devotion as a Saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I know this will cause you a lot of 
trouble, but even so...!"
choice_data_list: Oh, is that all it is!

text_block_list.text:
Relieved that it wasn't bad news, I turn 
my attention back to Red Desire.
choice_data_list:
I wasn't just standing by your side for 
nothing, you know

I wasn't just standing by your side doing 
nothing, either.

text_block_list.text:
For instance, when the "Crimson Wedge" 
manifested in Red Desire herself.

For instance, when she decided to keep 
racing domestically despite the onset of 
the "Scarlet Wedge."

It was true that I had agonized over it, 
and you could say it was a heavy burden. 
...And yet.
choice_data_list: I've overcome just as much as you have.
I've overcome just as much as you have.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: (—Ah. Ah... Ah!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(A Saint is one beloved by the world. One 
blessed by the world, and one who saves 
the world—)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It was you, wasn't it? The blessing the 
world bestowed upon me...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Accompanying the Saint without breaking 
through her trials, growing together, 
saving the world together... A precious 
gift from the world."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Because of you! Because you were there, 
I...!"
choice_data_list: ...I'd be glad if that's the case.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Phew...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...O Heaven, O Earth. Here and now, I 
renew my vow."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
As a saint chosen by the world, to guide 
everyone—and the world—to happiness for 
all time.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Together with the peerless blessing 
that all of you have bestowed upon me.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between Red Desire and 
myself...
